sources.label: Official ROXY Size Guides (Women's Apparel, inches)

notes: US surf and snowboard brand, women's counterpart to Quiksilver. Its Women's Apparel chart prints letter sizes XXS–XXL with US sizes 2–14, in inches only (cm here are converted at 2.54); it prints no UK or EU sizes. Swimwear tops sized by bra cup and bottoms separately, with their own chart. Outerwear and snowwear run generous for layering.
audit: Old /size-chart.html and /en-gb/size-guide 404 (no en-gb store; roxy.co.uk would not load). Guide is /pages/size-guides, Women's Apparel tab, inches only: cm = in x 2.54 rounded to 0.1, originals in _in. Ranges stored as ranges. UK/EU removed (not printed; old XS = UK 8 was a convention). XS 83/63/89 -> 81.3-83.8/61-66/88.9-91.4; M 92/72/98 -> 88.9-94/71.1-73.7/96.5-99.1; XL 103/83/109 -> 99.1-104.1/78.7-86.4/106.7-111.8. XXS and XXL added. Denim, Swim and Snow charts not stored. Notes corrected (no cm/UK site exists).
